the final head changes only the test-line allocation, and inspected historical screenshots establish earlier UI behavior rather than this retention fix. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Recurring reports, watchers, and reminders stop when automatic maintenance archives their idle creating conversation. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction resolves the documented interaction using existing owners, without adding configuration or weakening explicit archive/delete behavior. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this PR open: it fixes a current-main retention gap, and the previous hot-reload finding is resolved; Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main maintenance can archive an unprotected idle dashboard parent, and scheduled admission classifies that parent as archived and pauses its job; supplied Gateway evidence exercises the repaired flow, but this review ran no target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Preserving parents at the shared maintenance boundary fixes the cause while retaining explicit archive/delete pauses, existing retention settings, and occurrence authorization checks.
